metadata.name: asset_manager_escrow
metadata.description: Unified Cross-Chain Asset Manager for S-Token vaults

instructions.name: accept_adapter
docs: Accept a Pending AdapterBinding after the cooldown has elapsed.
Flips to Active and increments the registry count.

instructions.name: accept_adapter_cooldown
docs: Accept a pending `adapter_change_cooldown` update after the current
adapter cooldown has elapsed (manager-gated).

instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: Accept a pending authority transfer after the cooldown period has elapsed.
Must be signed by the proposed new authority.

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: New authority (must sign to prove they control the address)

instructions.name: accept_limits
docs: Accept pending limits after the cooldown period has elapsed.

instructions.name: accept_manager
docs: Accept a pending manager transfer after the cooldown period has elapsed.
Must be signed by the proposed new manager.

accounts.name: new_manager
docs: New manager (must sign to prove they control the address)

instructions.name: accept_processor
docs: Accept a pending processor transfer after the cooldown period has elapsed.
Must be signed by the proposed new processor.

accounts.name: new_processor
docs: New processor (must sign to prove they control the address)

instructions.name: accept_vault_role
docs: Consent to holding a vault role (CPI to stoken accept_role_assignment)

accounts.name: manager
docs: Escrow manager (must sign)

accounts.name: vault_config
docs: Vault config that proposed this escrow PDA for a role

instructions.name: bind_adapter
docs: First Active AdapterBinding with no cooldown (pool create / extras).

instructions.name: cancel_adapter
docs: Cancel a Pending AdapterBinding before accept (closes the PDA).
Cannot be used on Active bindings.

accounts.name: manager
docs: Manager — authorizes the cancel and receives the reclaimed rent.

instructions.name: clear_inflight
docs: Manager fallback: drop a stale InflightBridge entry after 24h.

instructions.name: close_adapter
docs: Close an Active-but-disabled AdapterBinding (frees the registry slot).
Decrements the registry count and closes the PDA. The binding must be
disabled first (`active=false`) so funds are not mid-flight.

instructions.name: close_asset_manager
docs: Close a paused asset manager. Custody accounts must already be closed.

instructions.name: close_custody_token_account
docs: Close an empty custody token account after harvesting Token-2022 fees.

instructions.name: disable_adapter
docs: Disable an Active AdapterBinding without unbinding (active=false).
Cannot be used on Pending bindings.

instructions.name: emergency_cctp_receive
docs: Emergency CCTP receive - force-complete a stuck CCTP transfer.
Allows receiving CCTP transfers even when paused (manager only).

accounts.name: manager
docs: Manager authorizes emergency CCTP receive (not processor)

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer for the MessageMarker account creation

instructions.name: emergency_return_funds
docs: Manager-gated return of custody to the vault ATA. Works paused or not.

instructions.name: emergency_sweep
docs: Emergency sweep tokens from a paused asset manager.
Requires asset manager to be paused and cooldown period elapsed.

instructions.name: enable_adapter
docs: Re-enable an Active-but-disabled AdapterBinding.

instructions.name: execute_bridge
docs: Bound-adapter CCTP send. Destinations live on the CCTP adapter instance.

instructions.name: execute_native_claim
docs: Execute a native claim via a bound pending-withdraw adapter
(processor only). Drains settled USDC into ESCROW custody and consumes
limits against the received amount.

accounts.name: config
docs: Globally paused blocks claim outright (no drain bypass at global level).

accounts.name: asset_manager
docs: AssetManager — note: per-binding `active=false` is OK (drain), and
`asset_manager.paused == true` is OK (drain). Only `force_paused` by
the authority blocks claim.

accounts.name: adapter_binding
docs: Bound adapter. Must be in Active status. `active=false` is allowed
(drain path). Must support pending withdrawals — claim is meaningless
for instant adapters.

accounts.name: adapter_program
docs: Adapter program (validated against binding).

accounts.name: adapter_instance
docs: Adapter instance PDA. Must match binding.

accounts.name: underlying_mint
docs: USDC mint (ESCROW underlying).

accounts.name: escrow_usdc_custody
docs: ESCROW USDC custody — claim sweeps into this account; we snapshot
before/after.

instructions.name: execute_native_deposit
docs: Execute a native deposit via a bound adapter (processor only).
Pre-transfers USDC custody to the adapter, then CPIs `adapter_deposit`.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config — read for pause state.

accounts.name: adapter_binding
docs: Bound adapter. Must be Active AND active=true.

accounts.name: adapter_program
docs: Adapter program (validated against binding).

accounts.name: adapter_instance
docs: Adapter instance PDA. Must match binding.

accounts.name: adapter_config
docs: Adapter's HumaConfig (or equivalent).

accounts.name: underlying_mint
docs: USDC mint (ESCROW underlying).

accounts.name: source_usdc_custody
docs: ESCROW USDC custody (source of pre-CPI transfer).

accounts.name: adapter_usdc_custody
docs: Adapter-side USDC custody (destination of pre-CPI transfer). The mint is
checked here; the handler additionally binds this to the bound instance's
custody PDA (`[TOKEN_CUSTODY_SEED, adapter_instance, underlying_mint]`
under `adapter_program`) so it equals the exact account the adapter
consumes as the Huma deposit source.

instructions.name: execute_native_withdraw
docs: Execute a native withdraw via a bound adapter (processor only).
Pending-style adapters do not consume limits here; instant adapters
consume limits against the received USDC delta.

accounts.name: adapter_program
docs: Adapter program (validated against binding).

accounts.name: adapter_instance
docs: Adapter instance PDA. Must match binding.

accounts.name: underlying_mint
docs: USDC mint (ESCROW underlying).

accounts.name: escrow_usdc_custody
docs: ESCROW USDC custody — used only for snapshotting the instant-redeem
branch. Validated PDA but only read here.

instructions.name: execute_swap
docs: Processor swap via a bound venue adapter (Titan / Jupiter / Kamino).

instructions.name: force_pause
docs: Force pause an asset manager (authority only).

instructions.name: force_unpause
docs: Force unpause an asset manager (authority only).

instructions.name: global_pause
docs: Pause the entire program globally (authority only).

instructions.name: global_unpause
docs: Unpause the entire program globally (authority only).

instructions.name: init_adapter_registry
docs: Initialize the per-AssetManager AdapterRegistry. Required before any
`propose_adapter` call. Manager-gated, one per AssetManager.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays for the AdapterRegistry rent.

instructions.name: init_asset_manager
docs: Initialize an asset manager for a specific vault.
Creates the per-vault AssetManager PDA with limits and authorities.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Authority that can create asset managers

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer for account creation

instructions.name: init_inflight_bridge
docs: Create the empty InflightBridge side-car for an asset manager.

instructions.name: init_token_account
docs: Initialize a token custody account for the asset manager.
Creates a PDA-owned token account for a specific mint.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The mint for the token account to create

accounts.name: manager
docs: Manager or processor may initialize custody ATAs (processor needs this
before `execute_swap` can buy the yield asset).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer for account creation

instructions.name: init_token_account_2022
docs: Token-2022 / TokenInterface custody ATA (N159).

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Initialize the global config account with CCTP v2 program IDs and settings.
Can only be called once by the initial authority.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The initial authority for the program

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's executable data account containing the upgrade authority

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer for account creation

instructions.name: pause
docs: Pause the asset manager (manager only).

instructions.name: probe_custody_roundtrip
docs: One-base-unit acquire→hold→return probe; writes `CustodyReadiness`.

accounts.name: custody_token_account
docs: Escrow custody ATA for `mint` (must already exist).

accounts.name: probe_token_account
docs: Funded probe ATA owned by `probe_authority`.

accounts.name: probe_authority
docs: Signs the inbound leg (probe → custody).

accounts.name: manager
docs: Escrow manager (factory_authority PDA when used from the factory).

instructions.name: propose_adapter
docs: Propose a new AdapterBinding (creates the PDA in Pending status).
Starts the adapter cooldown clock. Manager-gated. Use for replacements.

accounts.name: adapter_registry
docs: Existence required: any propose_adapter requires the registry to be
initialized. We do NOT bump count here — only on accept.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays for the AdapterBinding rent.

instructions.name: propose_adapter_cooldown
docs: Propose a new `adapter_change_cooldown` (manager-gated). Self-gated by
the current adapter cooldown; the new value must be >= the non-zero
floor `MIN_ADAPTER_CHANGE_COOLDOWN`.

instructions.name: propose_authority
docs: Propose a new global authority. Starts a cooldown period before the
new authority can accept the transfer.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Current authority (must sign)

instructions.name: propose_limits
docs: Propose new limits for the asset manager.
Starts a timelock period before limits can be accepted.

instructions.name: propose_manager
docs: Propose a new manager for an asset manager. Starts a cooldown period
before the new manager can accept the transfer.

instructions.name: propose_processor
docs: Propose a new processor for an asset manager. Starts a cooldown period
before the new processor can accept the transfer.

instructions.name: raise_cooldowns
docs: Manager: raise write-once change cooldowns. Refuses any value at or
below the current one. Dead knobs `processor_cooldown` /
`emergency_cooldown` are not exposed.

instructions.name: receive_via_cctp
docs: Receive USDC via CCTP from another chain (processor only).
Processes the CCTP message and attestation, minting USDC to custody.
Creates a MessageMarker to prevent replay attacks.

accounts.name: processor
docs: Processor executes the CCTP receive operation

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer for the MessageMarker account creation

accounts.name: message_marker
docs: MessageMarker is initialized here as a *secondary* replay guard.
`init` fails if it already exists, preventing double-processing.
Seeds include the full 32-byte CCTP V2 nonce (`extract_nonce_bytes`).
Authoritative replay protection is still MessageTransmitterV2's
`used_nonces`; this marker is defense in depth so a successful receive
cannot be replayed through this program even if the transmitter account
were somehow reset. I-5: this used to document an 8-byte truncation
that is no longer in the seed.

accounts.name: inflight_bridge
docs: In-flight side-car. Created empty on first receive if the keeper has
not yet called `send_via_cctp_v2`. Removal is a no-op when the inbound
message hash is not in `sent` (v1 send or EVM-originated mint).

accounts.name: usdc_custody
docs: The USDC custody account that will receive the minted USDC

instructions.name: return_funds
docs: Return funds from asset manager custody back to the vault.
Performs CPI to stoken::return_funds.
Can only be called by the processor.

accounts.name: asset_manager
docs: Asset manager instance account

accounts.name: returner
docs: The processor returning funds

accounts.name: vault_config
docs: S-Token vault config account

accounts.name: underlying_mint
docs: Underlying token mint (the vault's underlying asset)

accounts.name: asset_manager_token_account
docs: Asset manager's custody token account (source)
PDA: ["token_custody", asset_manager, mint]

accounts.name: vault_underlying_account
docs: S-Token vault's underlying token account (destination)

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config account for validating stoken_program_id

accounts.name: stoken_program
docs: S-Token program for CPI

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token program

instructions.name: set_cctp_programs
docs: Authority-only: set CCTP v2 TokenMessengerMinter + MessageTransmitter IDs.
Fixes configs initialized with V1 / swapped pins.

instructions.name: set_divest_override
docs: Manager-gated divest override (`until <= now + 24h`).

instructions.name: set_escrow_policy
docs: Manager-gated create/update of the EscrowPolicy side-car.

instructions.name: sweep_custody_dust
docs: Sweep non-underlying custody dust to the manager after the pause cooldown.

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Unpause the asset manager (manager only).

types.name: AdapterBinding
docs: Per-(asset_manager, adapter_program) binding record.
Created by `propose_adapter` (status=Pending), activated by `accept_adapter`
(status=Active, active=true) after `asset_manager.adapter_change_cooldown`
has elapsed. Can be toggled via `disable_adapter` / `enable_adapter` once
active. `cancel_adapter` closes the PDA while it's still Pending.
Seeds: ["adapter_binding", asset_manager, adapter_program]

fields.name: asset_manager
docs: AssetManager PDA this binding belongs to.

fields.name: adapter_program
docs: Adapter program ID (e.g. huma_adapter's program id).

fields.name: adapter_instance
docs: Adapter-side instance PDA (e.g. HumaInstance PDA).

fields.name: native_asset_mint
docs: Mint of the native-asset side (PST/mPST/etc).

fields.name: supports_pending_withdrawals
docs: True when this adapter exposes the deposit -> withdraw-request ->
claim lifecycle; false for instant-redeem adapters.

fields.name: active
docs: Convenience toggle: false disables execution without un-binding.

fields.name: status
docs: Status (Pending => requires accept; Active => usable subject to `active`).

fields.name: pending
docs: Pending change set during propose; cleared on accept.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Created timestamp.

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Last updated timestamp.

fields.name: adapter_count
docs: Registry adapter_count after the close (post-decrement).

types.name: AdapterRegistry
docs: Per-AssetManager registry that tracks how many AdapterBindings exist.
One AdapterRegistry must be created (via `init_adapter_registry`) before any
`propose_adapter` call. Bindings themselves live in their own PDAs (see
`AdapterBinding`); this registry only enforces the cap and exists as a
stable, easy-to-fetch summary record.
Seeds: ["adapter_registry", asset_manager]

fields.name: asset_manager
docs: The AssetManager PDA this registry belongs to.

fields.name: adapter_count
docs: Number of accepted (status=Active) adapter bindings currently
registered — i.e. those that have been `accept_adapter`-ed and not yet
`close_adapter`-ed. Incremented on accept, decremented on close. A
`disable_adapter` does NOT decrement it (the binding still occupies its
slot until closed). Bounded by `MAX_ADAPTERS_PER_ASSET_MANAGER` as a
concurrent cap.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Created timestamp.

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Last updated timestamp.

types.name: AdapterStatus
docs: Status of an adapter binding.
Pending = freshly proposed, not yet usable; binding sits in its PDA holding
the pending change details. `cancel_adapter` can drop it (closes PDA).
Active  = accepted after cooldown; can be enabled/disabled to gate execution.

types.name: AssetManager
docs: Per-vault asset manager instance.
Manages funds, limits, and cross-chain operations for a specific S-Token vault.

fields.name: index
docs: Unique index for this asset manager.
LAYOUT COUPLING (L-5): `huma_adapter::verify_escrow_caller` reads this
field directly from account bytes `[8..16]` (immediately after the
8-byte Anchor discriminator) to re-derive and authenticate the escrow
caller. `index` MUST remain the first field of this struct — reordering
it would silently break every adapter handshake.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed

fields.name: vault
docs: The S-Token vault this asset manager serves

fields.name: underlying_mint
docs: The vault's underlying token mint

fields.name: manager
docs: Manager authority - pause, governance proposals, emergency (manager paths)

fields.name: processor
docs: Processor authority - executes swaps, bridges, return_funds

fields.name: processor_cooldown
docs: Minimum seconds between processor operations

fields.name: processor_max_per_tx
docs: Maximum amount per processor transaction

fields.name: processor_daily_limit
docs: Daily limit for processor operations

fields.name: processor_daily_used
docs: Amount used today by processor

fields.name: last_daily_reset
docs: Timestamp of last daily limit reset

fields.name: last_operation_time
docs: Timestamp of last processor operation

fields.name: paused
docs: Whether this asset manager is paused

fields.name: force_paused
docs: Whether this pause was initiated by the authority via force_pause.
When true, only the authority can unpause (via force_unpause).

fields.name: paused_at
docs: Timestamp when paused (for emergency cooldown calculation)

fields.name: emergency_cooldown
docs: Required cooldown before emergency withdrawal (seconds)

fields.name: manager_change_cooldown
docs: Cooldown period before proposed manager can be accepted (seconds)

fields.name: pending_manager
docs: Pending manager change awaiting acceptance after cooldown

fields.name: processor_change_cooldown
docs: Cooldown period before proposed processor can be accepted (seconds)

fields.name: pending_processor
docs: Pending processor change awaiting acceptance after cooldown

fields.name: limits_cooldown
docs: Cooldown period before proposed limits can be accepted (seconds)

fields.name: pending_limits
docs: Pending limits change awaiting acceptance after cooldown

fields.name: adapter_change_cooldown
docs: Cooldown period before a proposed AdapterBinding change can be accepted (seconds).
AdapterBinding pending changes (creation via `propose_adapter`) use this
cooldown. Has a non-zero hard floor (`MIN_ADAPTER_CHANGE_COOLDOWN`) and is
itself governable via `propose_adapter_cooldown` / `accept_adapter_cooldown`.

fields.name: pending_adapter_cooldown
docs: Pending `adapter_change_cooldown` change awaiting acceptance.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation timestamp

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Last update timestamp

types.name: AuthorityChangePending
docs: Event emitted when an authority change is proposed and pending timelock

types.name: AuthorityUpdated
docs: Event emitted when a pending authority change is accepted and applied

types.name: Config
docs: Global configuration account for the Cross-Chain Asset Manager program.
Stores CCTP program IDs, authority, and global pause state.
Layout is append-only: do not insert or reorder fields. `schema_version`
may be absent on not-yet-realloc'd accounts and deserializes as zero.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority that can manage global settings and force-pause asset managers

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint address (required for CCTP operations)

fields.name: token_messenger_v2
docs: Circle CCTP v2 Token Messenger Minter program ID

fields.name: message_transmitter_v2
docs: Circle CCTP v2 Message Transmitter program ID

fields.name: stoken_program_id
docs: S-Token program ID for CPI validation

fields.name: paused
docs: Whether the entire program is globally paused

fields.name: next_asset_manager_index
docs: Counter for unique asset manager indices

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed

fields.name: created_at
docs: Timestamp when config was created

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Timestamp when config was last updated

fields.name: authority_change_cooldown
docs: Cooldown period before proposed authority can be accepted (seconds)

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Pending authority change awaiting acceptance after cooldown

fields.name: schema_version
docs: Set to 1 when this binary wrote the account.

types.name: CustodyReadiness
docs: Escrow-owned record that `register_pool` consumes for Token-2022 pools.

fields.name: readiness_hash
docs: Digest written at probe time — must equal `params.custody_readiness_hash`.

types.name: EmergencyCctpReceiveArgs
docs: Arguments for emergency CCTP receive operation

fields.name: message
docs: The CCTP message bytes

fields.name: attestation
docs: The attestation from Circle

types.name: EscrowPolicy
docs: Per-asset-manager execution policy (H-3 / M-9 / L-3 / L-4).
Seeds: `[b"escrow_policy", asset_manager]`.

fields.name: enforce
docs: When false, mark-floor / bootstrap refusals become events only.
M-9 route checks still refuse.

fields.name: max_execution_loss_bps
docs: Deploy tolerance (bps) when the vault mark is usable.

fields.name: divest_allowance_bps
docs: Extra bps added on every divest (default 300).

fields.name: stale_divest_allowance_bps
docs: Extra bps added on a divest when the mark is unusable (default 200).

fields.name: divest_override_until
docs: Unix timestamp; while `now <= this`, divests use `min_amount_out` only.

fields.name: mark_max_age_secs
docs: Vault mark freshness window (default 900).

fields.name: max_swaps_per_mark
docs: Max v2 swaps that may land against one mark timestamp (default 2).

fields.name: bootstrap_cap
docs: First-deploy USDC cap while `asset_custody_before == 0`.

fields.name: bootstrap_window_secs
docs: Bootstrap window length (default 86_400).

fields.name: bootstrap_used
docs: USDC spent in the current bootstrap window.

fields.name: bootstrap_window_start
docs: Window start (unix seconds).

fields.name: allowed_output_mints
docs: Output mints a v2 swap/Kamino ix may credit (≤ 4).

fields.name: max_fee_bps
docs: L-4: CCTP `max_fee` cap in bps of `amount`. 0 = no cap.

fields.name: swaps_since_mark
docs: Swaps counted against `last_mark_ts_seen`.

fields.name: last_mark_ts_seen
docs: Last vault `last_price_update_timestamp` we counted a swap against.

types.name: ExecuteNativeDepositArgs
docs: Args for `execute_native_deposit`.
NOTE: `AdapterDepositArgs` in the adapter program has the same layout and
MUST be kept in sync. We cannot depend on the adapter as a Cargo dep — the
adapter set is open-ended.

types.name: InflightBridge
docs: Per-asset-manager in-flight CCTP side-car.
Seeds: `[b"inflight", asset_manager]`.

types.name: InflightEntry
docs: One outstanding CCTP send (M-4).

fields.name: vault
docs: The S-Token vault this asset manager serves

fields.name: underlying_mint
docs: The vault's underlying token mint

fields.name: manager
docs: Manager authority (governance: pause, proposals, destinations, etc.)

fields.name: processor
docs: Processor authority (executes swaps, bridges, return_funds)

fields.name: limits_cooldown

fields.name: manager_change_cooldown
docs: Cooldown period for manager changes (None uses default 24h)

fields.name: processor_change_cooldown
docs: Cooldown period for processor changes (None uses default 24h)

fields.name: adapter_change_cooldown
docs: Cooldown period for adapter binding changes (None uses default 24h)

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint address

fields.name: token_messenger_v2
docs: Circle CCTP v2 Token Messenger Minter program ID

fields.name: message_transmitter_v2
docs: Circle CCTP v2 Message Transmitter program ID

fields.name: stoken_program_id

clears this.

docs: Whether the adapter supports the pending-withdrawal/claim lifecycle
